data.rationale: Threat intelligence confirms both the URL payroll-update.example-billing.net and attachment hash 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08 are malicious with scores of 90 and 95 respectively. User j.okafor has a history of prior true positive phishing incidents and confirmed clicking the credential-harvesting link on a personal device, indicating active compromise risk. The combination of a malicious macro-enabled attachment and confirmed user interaction warrants immediate escalation.
suggested_actions: Immediately reset credentials for user j.okafor and enforce MFA re-enrollment due to confirmed click on credential-harvesting URL.
Block domain payroll-update.example-billing.net and hash 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08 across email gateway and endpoint protection.
Search mail logs for other recipients of invoice_2207.xlsm or emails from the same sender to identify potential lateral exposure.
Interview user j.okafor to determine if corporate laptop was used to open invoice_2207.xlsm or visit the malicious URL.
Initiate forensic triage on any corporate device associated with j.okafor to check for macro execution artifacts or C2 beaconing.
